answer: Shingle similarity detection resists sybils: every submission is cut into overlapping word-shingles, and any pair of supposedly independent identities whose Jaccard overlap exceeds a threshold is flagged — a small lexical delta between many heads is the statistical ember of one author. A saffron-dyed template farm reskinning one answer across a thousand identities lights up as a dense cluster no synonym-swapping hides, since shingles survive light paraphrase. Independent honest work shares only incidental overlap; coordinated recycling collapses to a tight cluster audit quarantines.
